column7: Buying? Or selling?\n
column8: reads: 買いますか？売りますか？\n @from-ours

column6: いらっしゃい。{08:7F}薬有るよ。\n
column7: Welcome. I've got some good medicine here.\n
column8: reads: いらっしゃい。いい薬有るよ。\n @from-ours

column6: 何買い{08:5A}？ {08:7F}薬たくさん有るよ。\n
column7: What'll you buy? Got plenty of good medicine here.\n
column8: reads: 何買います？ いい薬たくさん有るよ。\n @from-ours

column7: You, you're not carrying anything we deal in.\n
column8: reads: あなた、うちで扱ってる物持ってないですね。\n @from-ours

column7: What'll you sell?\n
column8: reads: 何売ります？\n @from-ours

column7: Not enough money troubles me.\n
column8: reads: お金足りないの困りますよ。\n @from-ours

column7: This is everything you're buying, yes?\n
column8: reads: 買う物これで全部ですね？\n @from-ours

column7: You, carrying way too much stuff.\n
column8: reads: あなた持ち物たくさん持ちすぎです。\n @from-ours

column7: Can't go down that much. You want me hang myself?\n
column8: reads: そんなに負けるの無理です。\n私に首くくれ言うですか？\n @from-ours

column7: Hmmm...... How about this.\n
column8: reads: ウーン‥‥。これでどうでしょ。\n @from-ours

column7: Good! I'll sell it!\nCustomer good at shopping.\n
column8: reads: いいです！ 売ります！\nお客さん買い物上手ですね。\n @from-ours

column7: Thank you very much.\n
column8: reads: ありがとうございます。\n @from-ours

column7: This is everything you're selling, yes?\n
column8: reads: 売る物これで全部ですね？\n @from-ours

column6: {08:7A}に高く買え{02:0A}。\n私に夜逃げしろ言う{08:55}か？\n
column7: Can't buy that high. You want me skip town?\n
column8: reads: そんなに高く買えません。\n私に夜逃げしろ言うですか？\n @from-ours

column7: Hmmm...... How about this.\n
column8: reads: ウーン‥‥。これでどうでしょ。\n @from-ours

column7: Good! I'll buy it!\nCan't win against customer.\n
column8: reads: いいです！ 買いましょう！\nお客さんには勝てませんです。\n @from-ours

column7: Thank you very much.\n
column8: reads: ありがとうございます。\n @from-ours

column7: Ah, customer. Wait a moment please.\n
column8: reads: あっ、お客さん。ちょっと待って下さい。\n @from-ours

column7: Thanks as always. Still got plenty good medicine.\nCome buy lots more again.\n
column8: reads: 毎度ありです。いい薬まだまだたくさん有るよ。\nまたたくさん買って下さい。\n @from-ours

column7: Thanks as always. Come sell lots more again.\n
column8: reads: 毎度ありです。またたくさん売って下さい。\n @from-ours

column7: Thanks as always. Buy something again next time.\n
column8: reads: 毎度ありです。次は何か買って下さい。\n @from-ours

column7: This, a bonus. Thank you.\nBetter take it.\n
column8: reads: これ、オマケです。感謝です。\n受け取ると良いです。\n @from-ours
